csharpPlanner.excludedScope: Lifecycle access gates, duplicate receipt processing and invalid receipt-drop sequences belong to the future service, not PackingPlanner. CASE-22 confirms feasible planning before a hypothetical failed transfer; it is not a rollback test.

rejectedRuntimeAdvice: Do not replace inventory MassUtility.Capacity/FreeSpace with StatDefOf.CarryingCapacity, which relates to carrying in hands and is not the inspected inventory formula.
Physical silver escrow must retain actual Things via a serialized ThingOwner; Scribe_Values of a numeric escrow balance alone would not preserve the physical money.
The report's guessed TryAddOrTransfer signature and return meaning are not independent API evidence; use verified container overloads and actual observed ownership/quantity.
Do not infer a fixed drop radius, guaranteed failed placement from an occupied cell, or unconditional reservation cleanup from the arithmetic model.
textAdjustments: Arrival must not promise no overnight stay: no hotel room is different from a visit never spanning night.
Leaving status must not assert purchases when a group may leave empty-handed.
scope: Independent numeric and text review, not live wholesale AI, transfer, navigation, save/load or WorldPawns retention evidence.
